output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balanceOf[_to] are incremented without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of any user to any value.
The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] is incremented without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be set to any value.
The 'buy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[msg.sender] is incremented without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be set to any value.
The 'sell' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The msg.sender.balance is incremented without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be set to any value.
The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The sellPrice and buyPrice are set without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be set to any value.
